message.content:
The title of “best player in soccer today” is highly debated and depends on the criteria you value—goals, assists, influence on the game, trophies, or overall skill. As of now, a few names frequently come up:

| Player | Club | Position | Key Strengths |
|--------|------|----------|---------------|
| **Lionel Messi** | Inter Miami (MLS) | Forward | Vision, dribbling, play‑making, longevity |
| **Kylian Mbappé** | Paris Saint‑Germain | Forward | Speed, finishing, versatility |
| **Erling Haaland** | Manchester City | Striker | Physicality, positioning, goal‑scoring rate |
| **Kevin De Bruyne** | Manchester City | Midfielder | Passing range, creativity, work rate |
| **Neymar Jr.** | Al‑Hilal (Saudi Pro League) | Forward | Flair, dribbling, creativity |

If you’re looking at current form and impact in top European leagues, **Erling Haaland** and **Kevin De Bruyne** are often cited as the most dominant players right now. However, the “best” can change week to week depending on performance, injuries, and personal preference.
